extracted.name: Chocolate chip mug cake
extracted.description: Lower your energy use by baking this chocolate chip cookie pudding in the microwave. It takes just 10 minutes to make – perfect for a speedy dessert for one
ingredient_lines: 1 egg yolk (freeze the white for another recipe)
instruction_lines: Put the butter and sugar in a microwave-safe cup or ramekin and microwave on high for 30-50 seconds (longer if using fridge-cold butter) until melted.

Stir in the egg yolk until glossy and combined. Stir in a pinch of salt and the vanilla. Add the flour, baking powder and chocolate chips. Microwave on high for 1 min until puffed and golden. Remove and leave for a few minutes before serving with ice cream, if you like.
